courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: Our application is nearing its completion but one thing is missing and that is user authentication.
Thus far, we have our user login form but we're not doing anything with the input entered there.
This will change in this module and I will show you how you could add authentication to an Ionic app
and for this, you'll first of all learn how authentication works in Ionic apps because there is a specific
then we'll add authentication to our application, we'll add users sign-up and login and last but not
least, I will show you how to manage that authentication token which you'll get which is related to the
first part where I explain how authentication works.
So let's start with that part then.
